title: Adaptive micro-latency-span instrumentation and multi-region failover diagnostic buildout
creator: Marco Silva
description: Instrument a new "micro-latency-span" surface that captures per-suboperation latency (decode-step, kv-lookup, prefix-cache, network-hop) across request lifecycles and wire these signals into multi-region dashboards and a failover diagnostic panel. The goal is to create SLIs that reflect the smallest latency contributors so we can: 1) detect emerging tail sources earlier, 2) drive smarter adaptive shedding decisions, and 3) have a single diagnostic canvas for multi-region failover rehearsals.
acceptance_criteria: Micro-latency-span emitted for every inference request with standard fields: span_id, parent_id, op_type (decode|kv|cache|net), duration_ms, model_version, region, tenant_id, seq_length
Influx/TS DB or tracing backend receives these spans at production scale for sampled traffic (currently 5%) without >1% extra CPU on frontends
New SLIs added: per-sequence-length P50/P95/P99 of decode-step, kv-lookup hit-rate, and prefix-cache latency; SLOs defined for customer-impacting tiers
Dashboard: multi-region heatmap with cohorting by region, model, and sequence-length; single-failure-rehearsal panel to visualize circuit state and recommended actions
Failover diagnostic playbook linked from dashboard with runbook steps and rollback criteria
Can run synthetic failover rehearsal (chaos: region blackhole) in staging and validate dashboards and alerting workflow
